script: const f={family:'Inter',style:'Regular'};await pixso.loadFontAsync(f);const results=[];for(const id of ['3:123','7:16661']){const root=pixso.getNodeById(id);const timer=root.findOne(n=>n.type==='INSTANCE'&&n.name.startsWith('Phase timer'));const label=timer.findOne(n=>n.name==='Timer context');const nav=timer.parent;const existing=nav.children.find(n=>n.name==='Timer phase label · Раунд');if(existing)throw Error('Label already exists');const x=timer.x+label.x;const y=timer.y+label.y;const box=pixso.createFrame();box.name='Timer phase label · Раунд';box.fills=[{type:'SOLID',color:{r:33/255,g:27/255,b:45/255}}];box.resize(label.width,label.height);nav.appendChild(box);box.layoutPositioning='ABSOLUTE';box.x=x;box.y=y;const text=pixso.createText();text.fontName=f;text.fontSize=14;text.fills=[{type:'SOLID',color:{r:183/255,g:175/255,b:197/255}}];text.characters='Раунд';box.appendChild(text);if(text.characters!=='Раунд'||text.hasMissingFont)throw Error('Incorrect timer label');results.push({id,timer:timer.id,label:box.id,x:box.x,y:box.y,w:box.width,h:box.height});}return{verified:true,results};
